senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. to use אַפְצָא q. v., to dress or prepare with gall-nut juice.—Part. pass. אָפִיץ, עָפִיץ.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 19a:1">Meg. 19ᵃ</cite> top <he>ולא א׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="P00001"><he>ע׳</he></cite>) a skin not moistened with gall-nut.
<cite ref="Gittin 19a:15">Gitt. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>הא דאֲפִיצָן</he> Rashi (ed. <he>אפיץ</he>) in the one case it means when the parchment has been dressed &c.
